name: quay_list_agents
description: List the peers on Quay's A2A bus: their terminal IDs, names, run kind, bus level and live status (Working, Idle, Waiting, etc.). A full peer sends messages and replies; a responder replies but can't send; a listener gets messages but can't reply. Shell and Archon terminals are not peers and are not listed.

name: quay_send_message
description: Send a prompt or task delegation to another peer in Quay. Can optionally wait for the peer to finish its turn and return its reply directly to you. A listener can't reply, so a wait on one returns at once and says why.

target_terminal_id.description: The peer's exact terminal ID or exact session name, e.g. from quay_list_agents. Nothing else matches: no run kind, partial name or partial ID. A session name matches live terminals only, those in your project first, and one that two of them share is refused as ambiguous; pass the ID then. An exited terminal is reached by its ID only, and a message to it is refused.

message.description: The prompt or task instruction to dispatch to the peer agent.

wait_for_reply.description: If true (default), waits up to 60s from this call for the peer to complete its turn and returns its reply. A wait on a listener returns at once.

name: quay_broadcast
description: Broadcast a notification or status update to every other running peer in your project. A worktree counts as its own project. You never get your own notice, and shell and Archon terminals are skipped. A peer in a turn gets it when that turn ends.

name: quay_get_agent_status
description: Check the live status (starting, working, waiting, idle, exited or unknown), current task and auto-approved action count of a specific peer agent in Quay.

terminal_id.description: The peer's exact terminal ID or exact session name, e.g. from quay_list_agents. Nothing else matches: no run kind, partial name or partial ID. A session name matches live terminals only, those in your project first, and one that two of them share is refused as ambiguous; pass the ID then. An exited terminal is reached by its ID only, and a message to it is refused.

name: machina_submit_work_order
description: Submit a work order to Machina, Quay's software factory. It waits on hold until a human admits it; Machina then creates a git worktree and branch for it under .machina/worktrees/ and vaults .machina/holdbacks/. A human launches the author agent and merges the result.

project_path.description: Any path inside the git repository.

objective.description: What the author agent must do.

allowed_output_paths.description: Repo-relative globs the author may change, e.g. src/slices/auth/**.

base_branch.description: Defaults to the main checkout's current branch.

author_agent.description: Agent CLI that will do the work, e.g. claude. Defaults to claude.

name: machina_get_work_order
description: Read a Machina work order: objective, allowed and protected paths, attempts, and the latest gate findings. Holdback (Tier 2) details are withheld.

name: machina_submit_deliverable
description: Submit your work on a Machina work order to the gate. The gate commits the worktree, checks changed paths, runs the pre-PR audit and the project's configured build, test and holdback commands. It runs in the background; when you are the work order's author terminal, the verdict is typed into your terminal when it finishes.
